# The country stops being centaur: a change of race (doc 44, section 4.4).
DA_RH_leave_centaur = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_race.centaur
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_changed_race
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_grace
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_grace	# the grace period starts again
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.centaur	# kept while the grace lasts
}
# The country becomes centaur, or is read for the first time.
DA_RH_enter_centaur = {
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_race.centaur
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_had.centaur
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.centaur	# the country's race again, not only kept
}
# The country stops being dwarven: a change of race (doc 44, section 4.4).
DA_RH_leave_dwarven = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_race.dwarven
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_changed_race
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_grace
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_grace	# the grace period starts again
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.dwarven	# kept while the grace lasts
	DA_PR_pause_page_unique = yes	# rule 6: its running research waits, with its progress
	clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Unique_1	# the race tab shows the new race
	set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }	# a queued research of its page may not start
}

# The country stops being elven: a change of race (doc 44, section 4.4).
DA_RH_leave_elven = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_race.elven
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_changed_race
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_grace
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_grace	# the grace period starts again
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.elven	# kept while the grace lasts
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { OR = { DA_RH_is_ruinborn = yes } } }
		DA_PR_pause_page_race_elven = yes
		clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Unique_1
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
	}
}

# The country stops being ogre: a change of race (doc 44, section 4.4).
DA_RH_leave_ogre = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_race.ogre
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_changed_race
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_grace
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_grace	# the grace period starts again
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.ogre	# kept while the grace lasts
}
# The country becomes ogre, or is read for the first time.
DA_RH_enter_ogre = {
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_race.ogre
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_had.ogre
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.ogre	# the country's race again, not only kept
}
# The country stops being orcish: a change of race (doc 44, section 4.4).
DA_RH_leave_orcish = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_race.orcish
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_changed_race
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_grace
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_grace	# the grace period starts again
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.orcish	# kept while the grace lasts
}
# The country becomes orcish, or is read for the first time.
DA_RH_enter_orcish = {
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_race.orcish
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_had.orcish
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.orcish	# the country's race again, not only kept
}
# The country stops being ruinborn: a change of race (doc 44, section 4.4).
DA_RH_leave_ruinborn = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_race.ruinborn
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_changed_race
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_grace
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_grace	# the grace period starts again
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.ruinborn	# kept while the grace lasts
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { OR = { DA_RH_is_elven = yes } } }
		DA_PR_pause_page_race_elven = yes
		clr_country_flag = DA_projects_research_Interface_on_Unique_1
		set_variable = { which = DA_PR_queued value = 0 }
	}
}
# The country becomes ruinborn, or is read for the first time.
DA_RH_enter_ruinborn = {
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_race.ruinborn
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_had.ruinborn
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.ruinborn	# the country's race again, not only kept
	DA_RH_sync_elven = yes	# its living bonuses follow
}
# The country stops being troll: a change of race (doc 44, section 4.4).
DA_RH_leave_troll = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_race.troll
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_changed_race
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_grace
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_grace	# the grace period starts again
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.troll	# kept while the grace lasts
}
# The country becomes troll, or is read for the first time.
DA_RH_enter_troll = {
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_race.troll
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_has_race
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_had.troll
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.troll	# the country's race again, not only kept
}

# Once a year: the race again, then the former races of a country that changed race (kept or dormant).
DA_RH_yearly = {
	DA_RH_refresh = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_changed_race }
		DA_RH_test_kept = yes
	}
}
# Kept while the grace lasts or its people pass the test; dormant otherwise. Its living bonuses follow.
DA_RH_test_kept = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_had.centaur
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_race.centaur }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.centaur
				NOT = { DA_RH_keeps_centaur = yes }
			}
			clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.centaur	# dormant: its people are gone
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.centaur }
				DA_RH_keeps_centaur = yes
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.centaur	# kept again: its people are back
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_had.dwarven
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_race.dwarven }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.dwarven
				NOT = { DA_RH_keeps_dwarven = yes }
			}
			clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.dwarven	# dormant: its people are gone
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.dwarven }
				DA_RH_keeps_dwarven = yes
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.dwarven	# kept again: its people are back
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_had.elven
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_race.elven }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.elven
				NOT = { DA_RH_keeps_elven = yes }
			}
			clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.elven	# dormant: its people are gone
			DA_RH_sync_elven = yes	# its living bonuses follow
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.elven }
				DA_RH_keeps_elven = yes
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.elven	# kept again: its people are back
			DA_RH_sync_elven = yes	# its living bonuses follow
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_had.gnollish
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_race.gnollish }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.gnollish
				NOT = { DA_RH_keeps_gnollish = yes }
			}
			clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.gnollish	# dormant: its people are gone
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.gnollish }
				DA_RH_keeps_gnollish = yes
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.gnollish	# kept again: its people are back
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_had.gnomish
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_race.gnomish }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.gnomish
				NOT = { DA_RH_keeps_gnomish = yes }
			}
			clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.gnomish	# dormant: its people are gone
			DA_RH_sync_gnomish = yes	# its living bonuses follow
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.gnomish }
				DA_RH_keeps_gnomish = yes
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.gnomish	# kept again: its people are back
			DA_RH_sync_gnomish = yes	# its living bonuses follow
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_had.goblin
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_race.goblin }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.goblin
				NOT = { DA_RH_keeps_goblin = yes }
			}
			clr_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.goblin	# dormant: its people are gone
			DA_RH_sync_goblin = yes	# its living bonuses follow
		}
		if = {

				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.goblin }
				DA_RH_keeps_goblin = yes
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_RH_kept.goblin	# kept again: its people are back
			DA_RH_sync_goblin = yes	# its living bonuses follow

	if = {

			}

# Living bonuses of the elven heritage: on while it is active, off while it is dormant.
DA_RH_sync_elven = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.elven.EL_Abj1
			OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj1 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj1 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj1
			NOT = { OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes } }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.elven.EL_Abj3
			OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj3 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj3 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj3
			NOT = { OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes } }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj3
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.elven.EL_Abj4
			OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj4 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj4 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj4
			NOT = { OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes } }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Abj4
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.elven.EL_Con1
			OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con1 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con1 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con1
			NOT = { OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes } }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.elven.EL_Con2
			OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con2 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con2 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con2
			NOT = { OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes } }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con2
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.elven.EL_Con3
			OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con3 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con3 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con3
			NOT = { OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes } }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con3
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.elven.EL_Con4
			OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con4 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con4 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con4
			NOT = { OR = { DA_RH_active_elven = yes DA_RH_active_ruinborn = yes } }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_EL_Con4
	}
	if = {
		limit = {

	set_country_flag = DA_RH_done.elven.EL_Tra3
	DA_RH_sync_elven = yes
}

# Living bonuses of the gnomish heritage: on while it is active, off while it is dormant.
DA_RH_sync_gnomish = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Workshop
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Workshop }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Workshop duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Workshop
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Workshop
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Lead_School
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Lead_School }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Lead_School duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Lead_School
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Lead_School
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Levies
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Levies }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Levies duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Levies
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Levies
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Tinkers
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Tinkers }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Tinkers duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Tinkers
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Tinkers
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Bureau
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Bureau }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Bureau duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Bureau
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Bureau
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Medicine
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Medicine }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Medicine duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Medicine
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Medicine
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Listening_Brass
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Listening_Brass }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Listening_Brass duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Listening_Brass
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Listening_Brass
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Clockwork_Hierarchy
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Clockwork_Hierarchy }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Clockwork_Hierarchy duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Clockwork_Hierarchy
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Clockwork_Hierarchy

			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Guildhouses
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Guildhouses }

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Guildhouses
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Guildhouses
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Sprockets
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Sprockets }

		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Sprockets duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Sprockets
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Sprockets
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Districts
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Districts }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Districts duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Districts
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Districts
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Bombards
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Bombards }
		}

	}
	if = {

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Gun_Decks
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Gun_Decks }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Gun_Decks duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Gun_Decks
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Gun_Decks
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Shipwrights
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Shipwrights }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Shipwrights duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Shipwrights
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Shipwrights
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Admiralty
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Admiralty }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GN_Admiralty duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Admiralty
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GN_Admiralty
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.gnomish.GN_Unsinkable
			DA_RH_active_gnomish = yes

# Living bonuses of the goblin heritage: on while it is active, off while it is dormant.
DA_RH_sync_goblin = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.goblin.GB_EPP
			DA_RH_active_goblin = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GB_EPP }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GB_EPP duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GB_EPP
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_goblin = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GB_EPP
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.goblin.GB_Goblinfire

		}

			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.goblin.GB_Wasphouses

			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GB_Wasphouses }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_GB_Wasphouses duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GB_Wasphouses
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_goblin = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GB_Wasphouses
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.goblin.GB_Smog
			DA_RH_active_goblin = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_GB_Smog }

# Living bonuses of the lizardfolk heritage: on while it is active, off while it is dormant.
DA_RH_sync_lizardfolk = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = DA_RH_done.lizardfolk.LZ_One1
			DA_RH_active_lizardfolk = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_LZ_One1 }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_PR_mod_LZ_One1 duration = -1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_LZ_One1
			NOT = { DA_RH_active_lizardfolk = yes }
		}
		remove_country_modifier = DA_PR_mod_LZ_One1

	if = {

	set_country_flag = DA_RH_done.lizardfolk.LZ_Two3
	DA_RH_sync_lizardfolk = yes
}

# ---- The Racial Heritage hub (build_racial_hub.py) ----
DA_RH_open_hub = {
	DA_RH_refresh = yes
	set_country_flag = DA_RH_hub_on
}
DA_RH_close_hub = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_hub_on
}
# The top-bar button closes whatever heritage window is open.
DA_RH_close_windows = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_hub_on
	if = {
		limit = { DA_has_wonders_etc_interface_open = yes }
		DA_close_wonders_etc_interface = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_EL_archive_on }
		DA_EL_close_archive = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GB_boomworks_on }
		DA_GB_close_boomworks = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_KB_forge_on }
		DA_KB_close_forge = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_GN_workshop_on }
		DA_GN_close_workshop = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_LZ_hall_on }
		DA_LZ_close_hall = yes
	}
}
# The plaque of the Dwarven Hall: the hub gives way to the hall.
DA_RH_open_hall_dwarven = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_hub_on
	DA_initialise_interface_variables = yes
	DA_DH_init = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_has_any_racial_dwarven_interface_active_trigger = yes } }
		DA_first_open_wonders_etc_interface = yes
	}
	DA_open_wonders_etc_interface = yes
}
# The plaque of the Remnant Archive: the hub gives way to the hall.
DA_RH_open_hall_elven = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_hub_on
	DA_EL_open_archive = yes
}
# The plaque of the Boomworks: the hub gives way to the hall.
DA_RH_open_hall_goblin = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_hub_on
	DA_GB_open_boomworks = yes
}
# The plaque of the Brood-Forge: the hub gives way to the hall.
DA_RH_open_hall_kobold = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_hub_on
	DA_KB_open_forge = yes
}
# The plaque of the Gommo Workshop: the hub gives way to the hall.
DA_RH_open_hall_gnomish = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_hub_on
	DA_GN_open_workshop = yes
}
# The plaque of the Hall of Recitation: the hub gives way to the hall.
DA_RH_open_hall_lizardfolk = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_RH_hub_on
	DA_LZ_open_hall = yes
}

# ---- The AI (doc 44, section 7): one yearly action per race, never with the AI strength "None" ----
DA_RH_ai_pulse = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_gnomish = yes
				NOT = { DA_RH_monstrous = yes }
			}
			random = {
				chance = 20
				DA_GN_ai_act = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_gnomish = yes
				DA_RH_monstrous = yes
			}
			random = {
				chance = 10
				DA_GN_ai_act = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_goblin = yes
				NOT = { DA_RH_monstrous = yes }
			}
			random = {
				chance = 20
				DA_GB_ai_tile = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_goblin = yes
				DA_RH_monstrous = yes
			}
			random = {
				chance = 10
				DA_GB_ai_tile = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_kobold = yes
				NOT = { DA_RH_monstrous = yes }
			}
			random = {
				chance = 20
				DA_KB_ai_tile = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_kobold = yes
				DA_RH_monstrous = yes
			}
			random = {
				chance = 10
				DA_KB_ai_tile = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_elven = yes
				NOT = { DA_RH_monstrous = yes }
			}
			random = {
				chance = 20
				DA_EL_ai_act = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_elven = yes
				DA_RH_monstrous = yes
			}
			random = {
				chance = 10
				DA_EL_ai_act = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_ruinborn = yes
				NOT = { DA_RH_monstrous = yes }
			}
			random = {
				chance = 20
				DA_EL_ai_act = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_ruinborn = yes
				DA_RH_monstrous = yes
			}
			random = {
				chance = 10
				DA_EL_ai_act = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_lizardfolk = yes
				NOT = { DA_RH_monstrous = yes }
			}
			random = {
				chance = 20
				DA_LZ_ai_act = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_RH_primary_lizardfolk = yes
				DA_RH_monstrous = yes
			}
			random = {
				chance = 10
				DA_LZ_ai_act = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
